headline: Quiet day: San Francisco signs a 45-day pause on data centers
body: A quiet Saturday. The one qualifying story was San Francisco Mayor Daniel Lurie signing a 45-day citywide moratorium on new data centers while planners study their impact, which lifted Tech Backlash by 0.07. Reversion edged up 0.08; most other endings drifted down slightly as earlier news faded. Successors stayed the leading family. Horizon Balance held at -14.10.

coming_up: San Francisco's 45-day moratorium can be extended while long-term rules are drafted
